events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed everything? MTV launched 45 years ago, kicking off with The Buggles. We're looking back at the videos that defined an era.

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, becoming the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-two years of 'Definitely Maybe'. Oasis's debut album dropped on this day, cementing their place in Britpop history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an iconic three-day event of peace and music, commenced on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock began. Which legendary performance still resonates with you?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering The King. Forty-nine years ago today, we lost Elvis Presley, but his legacy as a rock and roll icon lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, six days after a shooting incident in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Three decades since we lost a voice that shaped a generation. Remembering Tupac Shakur, who passed away on this day in '96.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a true guitar hero. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose innovative sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album 'Abbey Road', featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover, on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Crossing the road into history. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album, with that legendary cover, was released 57 years ago today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a Britpop icon, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine' album
events.blurb: John Lennon released his second solo album, the iconic 'Imagine', in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us a timeless message of peace with the release of his 'Imagine' album. A powerful listen today.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket," on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the revolution? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the first iPod, changing how we carry our music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen with 'Dr. No'. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering a legend. John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years young! Happy Birthday to the comedy genius John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty, what's your favourite moment?

events.title: The Beatles released "The White Album"
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as "The White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their diverse and experimental 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is your go-to?
